name: rogue
lore:
The Rogue is a creature of the periphery, thriving in the unseen niches of civilization and the wild alike. They inhabit the "spaces between"—the gloom of a rafter, the chaotic press of a marketplace, or the suffocating silence behind a heavy tapestry. Like the urban fox, they are opportunistic survivors, possessing an uncanny ability to turn an environment’s strengths into its vulnerabilities.

In behavior, the Rogue is a student of leverage. They do not possess the warrior’s blunt fury, but rather a cold, surgical precision. They observe, they wait, and they strike only when the advantage is absolute. Whether disarming a complex mechanism or slipping a blade between armor plates, their movements are defined by economy and grace. To a Rogue, every lock is a conversation and every shadow a sanctuary. They are the masters of the sudden end, proving that silence is the deadliest weapon an adventurer can wield.
